name: thincoder-vscode
description: ThinCoder AI coding assistant — prompts-driven, zero bloat

thincoder.providers.markdownDescription:
# Providers (legacy — migrated automatically)
Provider configuration now lives in `~/.thincoder/config.json`, shared with the CLI. On first activation any keys/providers stored here (and in SecretStorage) are migrated into that file and this setting is cleared. Use the in-panel Settings (⚙) or edit `~/.thincoder/config.json` directly.
thincoder.providers.deprecationMessage: Provider config is stored in ~/.thincoder/config.json (shared with the CLI). This setting is only read once for migration.

thincoder.stopTrace.description: Trace Stop/abort propagation hops to the "ThinCoder Stop Trace" output channel (latency debugging).

thincoder.project.followActiveEditor.markdownDescription: In multi-root workspaces, automatically switch the **current project** to the folder of the active editor. Sessions, search index, and agent working directory follow the switch. (Never switches while a task is running.)

thincoder.ui.autoFollow.description: Automatically follow new output in the chat panel (keep scrolling to the bottom). Turn off to keep your reading position while the agent works — explicit actions (scroll-to-bottom button, sending a message, loading the session) still scroll.

thincoder.ui.activityMaxHeight.description: Maximum height of the sub-agent activity area, in vh (percent of the panel height). Default 32.

thincoder.ui.activityTailLines.description: Number of preview lines shown in a collapsed sub-agent block (the dim tail under the header). 0 disables the preview; default 3.
